name: Daily Challenge
description: A daily roguelike run: pick a difficulty, grab cards at 25, 50 and 75%, climb the shared leaderboard.

language.name: Language
language.description: The language of the Daily Challenge window, the card picker and the run HUD. Korean text is drawn in a bundled font, so it works without any other mod.

sound-effects.name: Sound effects
sound-effects.description: Plays the card, countdown and shield sounds. They follow the game's SFX volume.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: Downloads the newest release straight from GitHub. Restart the game afterwards to apply it.
